symbolDescription: A link between two pins. Every visual member is an override: leave it out and the globe's matching `connection*` prop decides, so a set of links can share one look while a few of them break ranks.

optionDescriptions.from: `Pin.id` of the start point. An unknown id skips the connection with a development warning.
optionDescriptions.to: `Pin.id` of the end point. An unknown id skips the connection with a development warning.
optionDescriptions.archHeight: Overrides `archHeight`. Ignored when this link is drawn as a line.
optionDescriptions.animated: Draws a flowing stroke. A solid link has no pattern to move, so it is drawn dashed. Stops under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
optionDescriptions.data: Arbitrary consumer payload, passed through to `connectionComponent`.
